references.text: Edom refused to let Israel pass through their land, confirming their hostile attitude from verse 18
Sihon, king of the Amorites, also refused Israel passage and went out with his people to fight against them, a similar threat as Edom
Moses reminds Israel that they had to go around Edom's land because the Edomites denied them passage
Jephthah refers to how the king of Edom refused to let Israel pass through their land
The prophecy that two peoples in Rebekah's womb would be at war, fulfilled in the conflict between Israel and Edom
Esau's hostility toward Jacob, which explains the long-standing conflict between Edom and Israel
Obadiah's prophecy of Edom's judgment due to their hostility toward Israel, including refusing them help
Amos condemns Edom for pursuing his brother with the sword, reflecting the threat in this verse
